tools.name: supportbee_list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets of the shared inbox, newest activity first, with filters (assignee, team, label, requester, dates, spam/trash/archived). By default archived, spam and trashed tickets are left out. Each ticket has id, subject, labels, requester, assignee, replies_count, comments_count, unanswered, archi

tools.name: supportbee_search_tickets
tools.description: Full-text search over tickets (subject, body, requester) with SupportBee's search syntax, newest activity first. Spam and trash are excluded unless asked. GET /tickets/search.

tools.name: supportbee_get_ticket
tools.description: One ticket with subject, requester, labels, assignees, state and the first message text. Replies and comments are separate calls. GET /tickets/{id}.

tools.name: supportbee_list_replies
tools.description: The public replies (the conversation with the customer) of a ticket, oldest first, as text. GET /tickets/{id}/replies.

tools.name: supportbee_get_reply
tools.description: One reply of a ticket (text, replier, cc/bcc). GET /tickets/{ticket_id}/replies/{id}.

tools.name: supportbee_list_comments
tools.description: The internal comments (visible to agents only, never e-mailed) of a ticket, oldest first, as text. GET /tickets/{id}/comments.

tools.name: supportbee_get_ticket_audit
tools.description: What happened to a ticket and who did it (assignments, label changes, replies, archiving) with timestamps. GET /tickets/{id}/audit.

tools.name: supportbee_list_labels
tools.description: All custom labels of the company (name and color). Use a label name with supportbee_add_label or the label filter. GET /labels.

tools.name: supportbee_list_teams
tools.description: The teams of the company (id, name), optionally only those that have users in them, or only the token user's teams. GET /teams.

tools.name: supportbee_list_users
tools.description: The agents, admins and collaborators of the desk (id, name, e-mail, role, teams), or customer groups. Use the id as assigned_user or user_id. GET /users.

tools.name: supportbee_get_user
tools.description: One user or customer with role, teams, ticket counts and a few of their recent tickets. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: supportbee_list_snippets
tools.description: The canned replies (snippets) of the company: name, tags and text, to reuse in a reply. GET /snippets.

tools.name: supportbee_list_forwarding_addresses
tools.description: The support e-mail addresses (forwarding addresses) of the desk: id, name, the address tickets arrive at and the from address. GET /emails.

tools.name: supportbee_get_report
tools.description: A report as time-series data points (value, timestamp): tickets_count, replies_count or avg_first_response_time, optionally for one agent, team or label. Needs an admin token. GET /reports/{report}.

tools.name: supportbee_reply_to_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS AN E-MAIL to the customer. Posts a public reply on ONE ticket; SupportBee e-mails it to the ticket's requester and to the cc/bcc addresses you list (at most 10 addresses in total). It cannot be recalled. The reply comes from the token's user. For a note only your team sees, use supportb

tools.name: supportbee_add_comment
tools.description: WRITE: adds an internal comment to a ticket. Comments are visible to your agents only and are never e-mailed to the customer. POST /tickets/{id}/comments.

tools.name: supportbee_add_label
tools.description: WRITE: adds an existing label to a ticket (404 if the label does not exist; names come from supportbee_list_labels). Safe to repeat. POST /tickets/{id}/labels/{label}.

tools.name: supportbee_remove_label
tools.description: WRITE: removes a label from a ticket (the label itself stays; 404 if the ticket does not have it). DELETE /tickets/{id}/labels/{label}.

tools.name: supportbee_assign_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: assigns a ticket to ONE agent (user_id) or ONE team (team_id), not both. A ticket that belongs to a team can only go to a member of that team; assigning to another team removes the user assignee. The customer is not e-mailed (SupportBee may notify the assigned agent). POST /tickets/{id}/user_

tools.name: supportbee_unassign_ticket
tools.description: WRITE: clears the user assignee or the team assignee of a ticket. DELETE /tickets/{id}/user_assignment or /team_assignment.

tools.name: supportbee_set_ticket_archived
tools.description: WRITE: archives a ticket (archived=true, it leaves the open inbox) or moves it back (archived=false). Nothing is deleted or sent. POST/DELETE /tickets/{id}/archive.

tools.name: supportbee_set_ticket_answered
tools.description: WRITE: marks a ticket as answered (answered=true) or unanswered (answered=false) without sending anything. POST/DELETE /tickets/{id}/answered.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: supportbee_list_tickets, supportbee_search_tickets, supportbee_get_ticket, supportbee_list_replies, supportbee_get_reply, supportbee_list_comments, supportbee_get_ticket_audit, supportbee_get_user, supportbee_list_forwarding_addresses, supportbee_reply_to_ticket, supportbee_set_ticket_archived · Private data: supportbee_list_teams, supportbee_get_report, supportbee_reply_to_ticket · Public sink: supportbee_reply_to_ticket, supportbee_add_comment, supportbee_add_label, supportbee_assign_ticket, supportbee_set_ticket_archived, supportbee_set_ticket_answered · Destructive: supportbee_remove_label, supportbee_unassign_ticket, supportbee_set_ticket_archived, supportbee_set_ticket_answered.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: supportbee_list_tickets, supportbee_search_tickets, supportbee_get_ticket, supportbee_list_replies, supportbee_get_reply, supportbee_list_comments, supportbee_get_ticket_audit, supportbee_get_user, supportbee_list_forwarding_addresses, supportbee_reply_to_ticket, supportbee_set_ticket_archived · Private data: supportbee_list_teams, supportbee_get_report, supportbee_reply_to_ticket · Public sink: supportbee_reply_to_ticket, supportbee_add_comment, supportbee_add_label, supportbee_assign_ticket, supportbee_set_ticket_archived, supportbee_set_ticket_answered · Destructive: supportbee_remove_label, supportbee_unassign_ticket, supportbee_set_ticket_archived, supportbee_set_ticket_answered

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
